gameBrief.rawIdea: Create an original all-ages obby set across floating signal gardens. Players read a short pulse, choose the matching safe route, and may collect an optional non-purchasable signal shard without changing the required path.

intendedAchievement.statement: Deliver a readable mobile-first obby slice whose route-reading mechanic is original, fair, and server-authoritative.
intendedAchievement.observableOutcome: A new player can read the pulse, complete checkpoint two, and understand that its optional shard is not required or sold.

gameBrief.playerFantasy: Become a nimble signal gardener who reads living light and crosses floating islands by choosing the safe bloom path.

audience.sessionIntent: Complete a short readable route and improve through immediate, low-friction retries.

platformConstraints.requirement: The complete checkpoint-two route, feedback, and optional shard must remain usable on a small touch screen at the declared performance budget.

inputConstraints.requirement: Traversal requires only the standard movement control and one context action, with no precision multi-touch gesture.

referenceInputs.purpose: Use only the abstract pattern of a clearly ordered obstacle sequence as an originality-safe structural reference.

assumptions.statement: Players can understand a pulse-selected safe route when shape, motion, text, and sound reinforce the cue.
assumptions.validationPlan: Run the checkpoint acceptance test on touch devices and review completion telemetry without collecting personal data.

materialQuestions.question: May the checkpoint-two signal shard affect route access, timing, movement, or difficulty?
materialQuestions.materialImpact: A gameplay advantage would violate the approved optional-reward and monetization-safety boundaries.

answer.response: No. The shard is optional, non-purchasable, cosmetic-progression currency and never changes route completion.

successConstraints.statement: Checkpoint two remains completable whether the player collects or ignores the optional shard.
successConstraints.measure: Validated checkpoint completions across both shard choices
successConstraints.threshold: Both collect and ignore paths pass the acceptance test

firstSessionPromise.statement: Within eight minutes, the player reads a bloom pulse, crosses the indicated route, and completes checkpoint two with or without its optional shard.

second.playerAction: Read the pulse, steer, jump, and correct position on the revealed safe route.
second.systemResponse: Render color-independent route cues and server-confirmed checkpoint state without moving the player.
second.reward: Immediate clarity, landing feedback, and safe forward motion.

minute.playerAction: Attempt the checkpoint route, learn from a fall, and retry from the checkpoint entry.
minute.systemResponse: Restore the player quickly, repeat the route cue, and preserve a fair unchanged obstacle state.
minute.reward: Checkpoint progress and optional signal-shard collection.

session.playerAction: Complete the bloom route and decide whether to explore for the optional shard.
session.systemResponse: Persist validated cosmetic currency and report aggregate route-completion signals.
session.reward: A completed route plus cosmetic-progression currency when the shard is collected.

day.playerAction: Return to practice the readable route and save signal shards for cosmetic palettes.
day.systemResponse: Offer the same fair course rules and retain only server-validated cosmetic progress.
day.reward: Mastery and optional visual self-expression without gameplay power.

objectives.title: Cross Checkpoint Two
objectives.description: Follow the original pulse-selected route to the checkpoint exit; the nearby signal shard is optional.

success.condition: The server validates that the player entered checkpoint two, traversed its legal route, and touched the exit.

failure.condition: The player falls out of bounds or contacts a route tile that is unsafe for the active pulse.
failure.consequence: No progress or currency is granted and the player returns to the checkpoint entry.

recovery.trigger: A checkpoint-two failure is validated by the server.
recovery.playerAction: Retry after rereading the pulse cue.
recovery.systemSupport: Respawn at the entry, replay the shape and sound cue, and apply no currency penalty.

stages.name: Checkpoint Two
stages.unlockCondition: Enter checkpoint two through the server-authorized course sequence.
stages.reward: Unlock the next route and retain any server-validated optional signal shard.

progression.resetPolicy: Failures reset only the active checkpoint attempt; validated cosmetic currency persists and never buys route progress.

sources.name: Optional Route Shard
sources.cadence: Once per server-authorized checkpoint-two pickup per session

sinks.name: Trail Palette Unlock
sinks.purpose: Unlock an optional visual trail palette that never changes access, timing, movement, or difficulty.

safeguards.rule: Only the server grants or spends integer shards, rejects duplicate pickup claims, enforces the cap, and never converts shards into gameplay power.

runtimeRules.name: Checkpoint Two Authority
runtimeRules.trigger: A client reports a shard interaction, route contact, fall, or checkpoint exit.
runtimeRules.clientBehavior: Render replicated cues and send bounded interaction intents; never write checkpoint progress, route safety, analytics, or currency.
runtimeRules.serverBehavior: Select the safe route, validate checkpoint order and spatial contact, grant a shard once, persist progress, and emit completion analytics.

antiExploit.validation: Reject intents outside the active checkpoint, legal contact volume, checkpoint order, shard availability, or plausible server-observed movement window.
antiExploit.violationResponse: Drop invalid intents, withhold progress and currency, record a safety event, and escalate repeated abuse for review.

runtimeRules.name: Route Cue Presentation
runtimeRules.trigger: The server replicates a new checkpoint-two pulse state or the player changes an accessibility preference.
runtimeRules.clientBehavior: Present the replicated route through shape, restrained motion, text, and sound while respecting reduced motion.
runtimeRules.serverBehavior: Replicate only an allowed pulse-state enum and ignore client attempts to select or complete a route.

antiExploit.validation: Accept only allowlisted accessibility preference values; pulse selection and completion remain server-owned.
antiExploit.violationResponse: Ignore malformed preference updates and retain the last valid accessible presentation.

sceneNodes.name: Signal Bloom Checkpoint Two
sceneNodes.purpose: Provide a short pulse-reading traversal route with one clearly optional, non-purchasable shard beside the critical path.
sceneNodes.entryCondition: The server confirms the player arrived through the authorized course sequence.
sceneNodes.exitCondition: The server validates the legal route and checkpoint exit, regardless of whether the shard was collected.

systems.name: Signal Bloom Course Authority
systems.responsibility: Own route selection, legal checkpoint state, shard grants, persistence, and validated completion analytics.

systems.name: Signal Bloom Accessible Presentation
systems.responsibility: Render server-selected route cues and feedback across visual, text, audio, and reduced-motion modes.

feedback.trigger: Checkpoint two reveals its server-selected safe route or validates completion.
feedback.message: Show the safe route with a distinct flower shape, high-contrast outline, restrained pulse, and explicit Optional Shard label.
feedback.accessibilityFallback: Pair the cue with a short directional tone and text route label; use a static outline when reduced motion is enabled.

notes: Every color cue also uses a distinct shape, text label, and high-contrast outline.
Use standard thumb movement plus one context action; jumping remains the platform control.

allowedOffers.playerValue: An optional trail palette offers visual self-expression around already-earned route progress.
allowedOffers.safetyConstraint: The offer cannot alter access, checkpoint progress, obstacle timing, movement, difficulty, route cues, or shard earnings.

analyticsEventContracts.name: checkpoint_two_completed

acceptanceTests.title: Optional shard leaves the route completable
acceptanceTests.given: A player reaches checkpoint two with the existing server-authorized route available.
acceptanceTests.when: The player collects or ignores the optional signal shard and then traverses the legal route.
acceptanceTests.then: The same route remains completable, completion analytics record the shard choice, and no paid or mandatory advantage is introduced.

transformations.description: Transform a general escalating obstacle-course structure into floating gardens whose safe routes are revealed by original color pulses.
transformations.originalitySafeguard: Use original code, geometry, names, art, audio, interface, checkpoint rules, and pulse-routing mechanics; do not copy source expression.

corpusRecord.subject: Tower of Hell public Roblox game page

observations.claim: The public game page presents an obstacle-course experience and exposes a public visits signal.
observations.evidenceText: The publicly accessible Roblox listing identifies the experience and displays visits among its public-facing game information.

inferences.statement: A clearly legible obstacle-course loop is suitable for an originality-safe structural study.
inferences.limitations: The public page does not establish private retention, conversion, revenue, or player-level behavior.

patterns.name: Progressive obstacle sequence
patterns.description: A sequence of increasingly demanding traversal challenges gives players a clear forward goal.

adaptablePatterns.name: Progressive obstacle sequence
adaptablePatterns.structuralObservation: The public listing supports studying a broadly familiar obstacle-course progression structure.
adaptablePatterns.adaptationRule: Retain only the abstract idea of ordered traversal challenges and rebuild every expressive and mechanical detail for Signal Bloom Obby.

protectedExpression.description: The source game's name, presentation, distinctive assets, layouts, and identity remain protected expression.
protectedExpression.doNotCopy: Do not reuse the name, branding, map layouts, assets, code, audio, interface, or other distinctive source expression.

transformations.originalFormSummary: A linear sequence of traversal obstacles communicates escalating progress.
transformations.transformedConcept: Signal Bloom Obby uses original floating garden islands where timed color pulses reveal one of several short safe routes.
transformations.originalityMechanism: The setting, branching pulse-reading mechanic, geometry, progression, art direction, checkpoints, code, and feedback are independently designed.

originalityRisks.description: A generic obby can drift toward recognizable source presentation if reference details are copied.
originalityRisks.mitigation: Review all geometry, names, assets, interface, audio, and mechanics against the protected-expression list before approval.

replicationDecision.rationale: Only the abstract progression pattern is adapted, with explicit safeguards and an independently designed pulse-routing mechanic.
